newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL-Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Bank/Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave its key rates unchanged tomorrow at the start of a new central bank reserve accounting period, according to nine out of 10 analysts polled by Reuters.

One analyst said the Bank of Portugal could cut the repo rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 6.25 percent and the draining rate, used to drain funds from the money market, by 30 bp to 5.90 percent. He also said the emergency lending rate could drop by 30 to 40 bp.
The repo rate stands at 6.50 percent and the draining rate at 6.20 percent. The emergency lending rate is 8.30 percent.
All the analysts polled said they believed the Bank of Portugal had room to cut rates further.
The central bank will announce the new money market conditions at 1415 GMT tomorrow.
The answers to the questions are listed below:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the repo rate?
2. If the answer to question 1. is yes, by how much?
3. Will the Bank of Portugal cut the draining rate?
4. If the answer to question 3. is yes, by how much?
5. Has the Bank of Portugal room to cut rates further?
